Menu.ExcludedTrafficIps: Remote IPs to exclude (one per line, exact IPv4/IPv6 only)
Menu.IpExclusionInvalid: These rule lines cannot take effect:
Menu.IpExclusionStateIdle: Idle (no valid rule, or no live-speed demand)
Menu.IpExclusionStatePreparing: Preparing (starting the collection session and warming up)
Menu.IpExclusionStateBadRules: Invalid configuration (rule lines rejected, IP exclusion is NOT active)
Menu.IpExclusionStateNoRules: No valid rule (IP exclusion is NOT active)
Menu.IpExclusionStateAmbiguousAdapter: Ambiguous adapter attribution (IP exclusion is NOT active)
Menu.IpExclusionStateBackendFailed: Backend failed to start (IP exclusion is NOT active)
Menu.IpExclusionStateWarmingUp: Warming up (the first window is discarded)
Menu.IpExclusionStateNoEvents: No events received (IP exclusion is NOT active)
Menu.IpExclusionCaliberHint: Caliber note: once enabled, the live speed comes from TCP/UDP event statistics (transport-layer payload) and therefore differs from the raw NIC rate. Session/daily totals keep the original caliber and are never deducted twice.
Menu.IpExclusionAdminHint: Administrator rights are required to collect these events. Without permission, or if the backend fails, the UI shows "IP exclusion is NOT active"; the filtered speed is never shown as 0.
Menu.LiveGlassHint:
Live Glass captures the screen behind this window in real time.
While capturing, the panel may briefly disappear or flicker in screen recordings or screenshots.
Menu.ConfigWriteBlocked: Settings could not be read; your changes will not be saved
Menu.WebServerTip: Web enabled. Mobile access via LAN 'IP:Port' or remote 'IPv6:Port'.
Menu.WebServerFpsTip: When on, the web page also collects frame rate. It needs an extra tool and adds sampling overhead.
Menu.TaskbarAlignTip: Left side if Win11 taskbar centered. Offset: 10px -20px
Menu.TaskbarCustomLayoutTip: Note: Custom layout only available when enabled. Spacing: 6px -6px
Menu.TaskbarCustomTip: Set BG color close to system taskbar color.
Menu.name: Name
Menu.MonitorItemTip: Tip: Space in Name/Short hides label. Empty resets. Units support {u}+char.
Menu.ThresholdClamped: Value is out of range; adjusted to {0}
Menu.ThresholdCritRaised: Critical must not be lower than Warning; synced to {0}
Menu.ThresholdWarnLowered: Warning must not be higher than Critical; synced to {0}
Menu.CalibrationTip: Define hardware limits for accurate bars. Empty = Auto-learn.
Menu.GpuMonitorCountTip: In multi-GPU mode the top N GPUs by priority are monitored; temperature / load / power are shown per GPU
Menu.UseWinPerCountersTip: Disable if inaccurate. CPU/GPU/MEM/DISK read from sensors.
Menu.RefreshTip: This only sets how often the interface redraws. Normal hardware data is sampled at most once per second, so a smaller value does not sample more often.
Menu.MemoryCommitHint: Committed memory: shows the committed amount / the current commit limit (commit limit = RAM + page file commit quota; it is a separate metric from physical RAM usage)
Menu.PluginHint: Tip: Change name/unit/order in [Monitor Items] page.
Menu.PluginMarketGoEnable: Enable it on the Plugins page
Menu.PluginMarketHint: Plugins are declarative JSON only — no executable code
Menu.PluginMarketBuiltinProtected: This id conflicts with a built-in plugin; install rejected
Menu.PluginMarketHashMismatch: Download integrity check failed; install aborted
Menu.PluginMarketMissingHash: Index entry provides no SHA-256 digest; integrity cannot be verified, install aborted
Menu.PluginMarketIdMismatch: Downloaded id does not match the index; install aborted
Menu.PluginMarketNotManaged: Not installed via the market; cannot uninstall
Menu.PluginMarketTargetExists: Target file exists and was not installed via the market; refusing to overwrite

Menu.PluginMarketSelfCheck: Detected files that may have overwritten built-in plugins: {0}. Please delete them and reinstall.
Menu.CpuVoltageSourceTip: Auto: prefers the core supply voltage reported by the processor; when only a requested voltage (VID) exists it is clearly marked as a reference value. If a manually selected source disappears, the app shows «Source unavailable» and never silently switches to another voltage.

CpuVoltage.Measured: Core supply voltage (reported by the processor)
CpuVoltage.MotherboardVcore: Core supply voltage (motherboard Vcore, measured, ~3s refresh)
CpuVoltage.ReferenceOnly: CPU VID (reference value, not a measured supply voltage)
